title: Microfragmentation allocator for latency-stable prefill/decode
creator: Aisha Gomez
description:
Background: We observe that mixed workloads (short-chat, long-completion, embeddings-inflight) cause either tail latency spikes or throughput loss when using coarse-grained phase splitting. Existing phase splitters tend to over-fragment long prefill requests or over-bundle short decode-heavy flows, which hurts our latency SLOs for interactive tenants and reduces GPU utilization for batchy tenants.

Proposal summary: Implement a Microfragmentation Allocator (MFA) as an adaptive layer between admission control and the existing prefill/decode arbiter. MFA will create small variable-length "micro-slices" for requests, using a combination of kernel-hint grouping and attention-sparsity heuristics to pack micro-slices into GPU wavefronts. Key features: 1) per-tenant micro-credit buckets for fairness, 2) kernel-hint tags (quantized vs dense, fused kernels) used to prefer co-locating compatible micro-slices, 3) attention-sparsity estimator to guide packing density (dense attention -> smaller slices), 4) hedging thresholds to avoid micro-slice starvation, and 5) graceful degradation policy that collapses micro-slices into larger slices when utilization drops or latency rises.

Why this is novel: Unlike our existing phase-splitting experiments that primarily choose cut points at semantic phase boundaries, MFA operates at micro-token granularity with kernel affinity awareness. This allows both high P99 stability for latency-sensitive flows (by isolating short slices) and improved throughput for background flows (by opportunistic coalescing), while leveraging kernel selection hints to avoid kernel thrash on the GPU.
acceptance_criteria: MFA implementation gated behind a feature flag with config: micro_slice_min, micro_slice_max, kernel_affinity_threshold, tenant_credit_window.

Bench harness demonstrates <=10% throughput regression for batch-only workload when MFA is enabled with default config, and >=15% P99 tail latency improvement for interactive microburst workload on the same rigs.
No increase in GPU kernel-switch rate by more than 5% compared to baseline when kernel-affinity_threshold is tuned.
Automated tests for attention-sparsity estimator accuracy (within 8% of offline estimator) and packing deterministic behavior under replayed traffic.
Rollout playbook and rollback criteria documented and verified in staging, including metrics, dashboards, and alert thresholds.
implementation_notes: Add MFA node in runtime request path between admission and prefilling stage with feature-flagged activation.
Micro-slice metadata: tenant_id, kernel_hint, attention_density_est, credit_cost, ttl.
Kernel hints sourced from model manifest + lightweight runtime probe that samples initial prefill step to refine hint.
Packing algorithm uses a two-pass approach: candidate selection (tenant fairness window) then affinity-led bin-packing into next GPU wavefront.
Expose config knobs via Console: micro_slice_min (tokens), micro_slice_max (tokens), affinity_score_threshold, coalesce_timeout_ms.
Persist sampling counters for credit buckets in local shard-store with periodic reconciliation to central metrics to avoid split-brain.
experiment_plan: Phase A (staging): unit+integration tests, synthetic load test comparing baseline scheduler with MFA toggled, verify kernel-switch metric and p99-latency on short-chat trace.
Phase B (canary): enable MFA for 5% of traffic on canary nodes with conservative defaults: micro_slice_min=4, micro_slice_max=32, affinity_threshold=0.8, tenant_credit_window=30s.
Phase C (broad canary): increase to 25% traffic, run 24h soak, validate cost-per-token, p50/p95/p99, kernel-switch rate, and cost-efficiency.
Phase D (opt-in rollout): allow selected low-latency tenants to opt in via console toggle and monitor SLA impacts for 7 days before full rollout.
A/B test: compare default coalescing policy to aggressive coalescing (larger micro_slice_max) focusing on throughput and per-tenant latency fairness.
metrics: P50/P95/P99 request latency breakdown (prefill vs decode).
Tokens/sec per GPU and aggregate throughput.
Tenant fairness indices: 95th percentile latency delta between tenants with similar SLAs.
Micro-slice coalescing ratio: fraction of wavefronts containing >1 tenant slice.
Error/timeout rates and any increase in retries/hedged calls.

2025-11-12 - Liam Chen: Implemented staging harness and added kernel hint sampler. Found edge-case where attention_sparsity estimator underestimates for long-range sparse attention; added conservative floor for sparse models.
2025-11-15 - Priya Nair (SRE): Observed a 6% increase in kernel-switch metric on canary under default config. Proposed increasing affinity_threshold from 0.7 -> 0.85 and retrying.
2025-11-18 - Liam Chen: Tuned default affinity_threshold to 0.85; re-ran 12h soak on canary, kernel-switch delta reduced to 1.2% and p99 improvements persisted for interactive tenants.
